text: 今年二季度以来，外资积极布局A股。数据显示，截至二季度末，沪深港通北向资金持仓市值首次突破3万亿元人民币。而根据外资机构的调研及调仓动向，国内人工智能（AI）产业链的吸引力正持续凸显。根据已披露的2026年中报，截至二季度末，QFII跻身前十大流通股东名单的个股共有38只，持仓市值合计170.29亿元。而QFII持仓也呈现出鲜明的“头部化”特征，截至二季度末，上述38只个股前十大流通股东名单中QFII的持仓市值排名前五，依次为宁德时代、宏发股份、亚翔集成、先导基电、中船特气。（证券日报）
text_en: Since Q2 this year, foreign capital has actively positioned in A-shares. Data shows northbound holdings via Shanghai-Shenzhen Stock Connect exceeded 3 trillion yuan for the first time by end-Q2. Based on foreign institution research and positioning moves, the domestic AI industry chain's appeal is increasingly prominent. According to disclosed 2026 interim reports, 38 stocks had QFII in top-10 circulating shareholder lists by end-Q2, with total holdings of 17.029 billion yuan. QFII holdings show distinct "head-heavy" traits; among these 38, top five by QFII holdings value are CATL, Hongfa, Asia Union, Xiandao, and China Shipbuilding Special Gas. (Securities Daily)
